title: Retry a simulated asynchronous request
summary: Implement bounded retries against a deterministic sequence of simulated async responses.
requirements: responses is an array of simulated outcomes { ok: true, value } or { ok: false, error } in attempt order.
maxAttempts is a positive integer. Throw Error containing "Invalid attempts" otherwise.
Each attempt must await its simulated asynchronous Promise; on a failure, retry until a success or maxAttempts failures.
If all permitted attempts fail, throw an Error with the last attempted response’s error message.
If responses run out before maxAttempts, throw an Error containing "No response".
Inputs other than maxAttempts are valid.
hints: Validate the allowed number of attempts before the loop.
Wrap each response in Promise.resolve or Promise.reject; await and catch it.
Stop immediately after success and preserve the error from the last attempted failure.
